snapshot.text: Tax-funded public system run by the Ministry of Health. The health budget is close to RO 1 billion, and the ministry is localising services and planning domestic pharmaceutical factories.

priorities.title: Domestic pharmaceutical factories
priorities.text: 18 pharmaceutical factories are planned to strengthen supply security.

priorities.title: Localising care
priorities.text: Oman reports progress in delivering more specialised services in the country rather than abroad.
